Mod.Name: Dark Squall RE-REVAMPED
Mod.Author: Slimebucket + SquallTheRevenant + Nightfable
Mod.Description:
Dark Squall RE-REVAMPED "This is a reskin of Squall Leonhart's default outfit to make it resemble his Balamb Mercenary C alternate costume from Dissidia NT."
This mod works on both REMASTERED and OG2013 editions! On REMASTERED edition you have the choice between both REMASTERED and OG Models. https://www.nexusmods.com/finalfantasy8remastered/mods/58 - this is the mod mine is based off of. Darksquall created by SquallTheRevenant REVAMP done by Nightfable Further RE-REVAMP texture work, fixes, Junction 8 porting and catalog work by - Slimebucket OG2013 Dark Squall created by Slimebucket
